name: Dermatological Conditions Image Dataset for Skin Lesion Classification
description: A multi-class clinical dermatology image dataset covering distinct conditions: Acne vulgaris, Hyperpigmentation, Nail Psoriasis (pitting, onycholysis, subungual hyperkeratosis), Stevens-Johnson Syndrome / Toxic Epidermal Necrolysis (SJS-TEN), and Vitiligo. De-identified and shared for research in dermatological computer vision. Safeguard notice: Represents benign and reactive dermatological conditions; distinct from malignant neoplasia; strictly intended for academic research without diagnostic efficacy guarantees.
